description: Update a Brevo contact (PUT /contacts/{identifier}). Required: identifier. Optional: identifierType, attributes, listIds (add to lists), unlinkListIds (remove from lists), emailBlacklisted, smsBlacklisted.

attributes.description: Contact attributes to change, e.g. { FIRSTNAME, LASTNAME }

emailBlacklisted.description: Block or unblock the contact for e-mails

identifier.description: E-Mail, Kontakt-ID, SMS- oder ext_id (identifierType setzen)

identifierType.description: email_id | contact_id | ext_id | phone_id | whatsapp_id | landline_number_id

smsBlacklisted.description: Block or unblock the contact for SMS

name: update_brevo_contact
